svg.title: HedgeMaker — naira-inspired brand palette
svg.desc: Selected palette with green as primary, paper and ink neutrals, blue functional accent, lime and clay signature accents, mint and burgundy support, and original banknote-inspired line studies.
svg.text: Banknote depth + trust blue + electric lime + warm heritage red.
Selected palette. See design.md for the chosen wordmark, website typefaces, and color usage rules.
